results.title: Data-intelligence driven methods for durability, damage ...
results.content: This paper provides a comprehensive overview of machine learning and deep learning theories and models, and reviews the current research on their application to the durability of reinforced concrete structures, focusing on two main areas: intelligent damage detection and predictive modeling of material durability. Starting from the development of artificial intelligence technology and its key technologies, it systematically introduces the basic theories of machine learning and deep learning algorithms and models, considers multiple applications, and summarizes the research status of machine learning and deep learning in the field of durability of reinforced concrete structures from two perspectives: intelligent detection of damage in reinforced concrete structures and intelligent prediction of durability of reinforced concrete materials. Advancements in deep learning and machine learning technologies within the field of artificial intelligence offer innovative approaches for damage detection and material performance prediction of reinforced concrete structures. Existing studies consistently demonstrate that machine learning algorithms outperform traditional models in predicting concrete properties such as strength, resistance to chloride and sulfate corrosion, frost resistance, carbonation resistance, and the rebar corrosion process.
